output.title: termdiff – Fast Side-by-Side Diffs
output.tagline: Rust-powered git diff viewer for huge files
output.description_short: termdiff renders side-by-side, word-level diffs instantly in your terminal. Zero config, single binary, 38ms on 10k-line diffs.
output.description_long:
Replace your default git pager with **termdiff**—a blazing-fast, side-by-side diff viewer built in Rust. Engineered for senior developers and maintainers who review large diffs daily, termdiff renders 10,000-line changes in just 38ms, an order of magnitude faster than existing tools.

With true word-level highlighting, hunk navigation via single keystrokes, and seamless integration into existing git aliases, termdiff works out of the box—no configuration needed. It’s a single static binary that respects your `core.pager` settings and drops right into your workflow.

Trusted by engineers in monorepos and open-source projects, termdiff is MIT-licensed, Homebrew-packaged, and listed on Terminal Trove. Built with tree-sitter and crossterm for precision and performance.

Stop struggling with misaligned, sluggish diffs. See changes clearly, side by side, in milliseconds.
